newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE RAISES 406BLN DRACHMAS FROM T-BILLS, ZEROS.
newsitem.headline: GREECE RAISES 406BLN DRACHMAS FROM T-BILLS, ZEROS.

text.p: The Greek finance ministry said in a statement that it raised 406 billion drachmas ($1.5 billion) from sales of 12-month T-bills and two-year zero coupon bonds on February 28.

The 12-month T-bill featured a gross rate of 10.50 percent and raised 336 billion drachmas. The two-year zeros, with a yield to maturity of 10.1 percent, raised about 70 billion drachmas, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4 ($ = 266.3 Greek Drachmas)
